description: Reference schema. Demonstrates every Total CMS field type and its settings in one place. This schema is registered and resolvable but cannot be used to create a collection — it exists purely as a living, validated example to copy from.

id.label: ID
id.help: id field. URL-safe slug that names the object and appears in its URL. Every schema needs one. Here it auto-generates from the title.

title.label: Title
title.help: text field. Single-line plain text. Use for: names, headlines, short labels. Reach for text only when no more specific field fits — email, url, phone, date, number, select and toggle each validate and render better.

autogenText.label: Autogen Text
autogenText.help: text field with the autogen setting — value is generated from other fields. Use for: derived display strings you do not want editors to retype.

validatedText.label: Validated Text
validatedText.help: text field with property-level validation (pattern, minLength, maxLength). Use for: codes and identifiers with a known format, such as a SKU or a postcode.

hiddenSetting.label: Hidden via setting
hiddenSetting.help: Any field can be hidden from the form with settings.hide while still storing data.

textarea.label: Textarea
textarea.help: textarea field. Multi-line plain text, no formatting. Use for: summaries, excerpts, plain notes.

styledtext.label: Styled Text
styledtext.help: styledtext field. Rich text (Tiptap) editor storing HTML. Use for: article bodies and any content an editor formats with headings, links, lists or images.

code.label: Code
code.help: code field. CodeMirror editor for HTML/JS/CSS. Use for: embed snippets, custom CSS and raw markup that must not pass through the rich text editor.

email.label: Email
email.help: email field. Validated email address. Use for: any email address, never a text field.

phone.label: Phone
phone.help: phone field. Telephone number with formatting. Use for: any phone number.

url.label: URL
url.help: url field. Validated absolute URL. Use for: external links, social profiles, source links.

svg.label: SVG
svg.help: svg field. Sanitized SVG markup. Use for: logos and icons rendered inline.

time.label: Time
time.help: time field. 24-hour HH:MM. Use for: opening hours and start times that have no date.

secret.label: Secret
secret.help: secret field. Masked input for sensitive values. Use for: API keys and tokens. Stripped from MCP responses unless mcp.expose is set.

json.label: JSON
json.help: json field. Arbitrary structured data. Use for: free-form configuration an editor pastes. Prefer a card when the shape is known.

hidden.label: Hidden
hidden.help: hidden field type. Stored, never rendered as a visible input. Use for: values set by code, imports or autogen.

radio.label: Radio
radio.help: radio field with static options. Use for: one choice from two to five fixed values shown all at once.

select.label: Select
select.help: select field with static options. Use for: one choice from a fixed list (status, size, layout). For values editors grow over time, use a list field with propertyOptions instead.

checkbox.label: Checkbox
checkbox.help: checkbox field. Boolean. Use for: consent-style yes/no inside forms. For flags, toggle is the usual choice.

toggle.label: Toggle
toggle.help: toggle field. Boolean switch. Use for: flags such as featured, draft, published, in stock. Here it drives the conditional field below.

conditionalEmail.label: Conditional Email
conditionalEmail.help: Demonstrates conditional visibility + form-level required: only shown (and required) when Toggle is on.

number.label: Number
number.help: number field. Integer or decimal. Use for: quantities, counts, ratings, sort order. Never store a number in a text field.

price.label: Price
price.help: price field. Locale-aware currency input. Use for: money.

calcNumber.label: Calc Total
calcNumber.help: number field with the calc setting — computed (read-only) from other fields.

range.label: Range
range.help: range field. Slider with min/max/step. Use for: bounded values such as a percentage or a 1 to 10 rating.

date.label: Date
date.help: date field. Calendar date. Use for: publish dates, event dates, deadlines. Enables the date filters and sorting in Twig and the API.

datetime.label: Datetime
datetime.help: datetime field. Date and time. Here set read-only and auto-updated on save. Use for: timestamps and scheduled moments.

list.label: List
list.help: list field. A simple array of strings. Use for: tags, categories and keywords that editors add freely. propertyOptions offers the values already used in the collection, which is how blog categories work.

multicheckbox.label: Checklist
multicheckbox.help: checklist field. Multiple selections from static options via checkboxes. Use for: several picks from a short fixed set (amenities, features).

multiselect.label: Multi Select
multiselect.help: multiselect field. Multiple selections from static options via a dropdown. Use for: several picks from a long fixed set.

color.label: Color
color.help: color field. Stored in hex + OKLCH. Use for: brand and theme colors.

image.label: Image
image.help: image field. A single uploaded image with ImageWorks resizing. Use for: hero, thumbnail, photo, logo. Never store an image path in a text field.

video.label: Video
video.help: video field. An external video URL plus provider metadata derived on save, and an optional uploaded poster image. Use for: hosted video (YouTube, Vimeo and others) referenced by URL. Top-level only in Phase 1.

gallery.label: Gallery
gallery.help: gallery field. An array of image objects. Use for: several images on one object.

file.label: File
file.help: file field. A single uploaded file. Use for: a PDF, download or attachment.

depot.label: Depot
depot.help: depot field. A managed set of files and folders. Use for: document libraries and download areas.

password.label: Password
password.help: password field. Stored as an encrypted hash. Use for: login credentials on user schemas only.

localizedtext.label: Localized Text
localizedtext.help: localizedtext field. Locale-keyed single-line text (Pro). Use for: short strings translated per locale.

localizedtextarea.label: Localized Textarea
localizedtextarea.help: localizedtextarea field. Locale-keyed multi-line text (Pro). Use for: plain text translated per locale.

localizedstyledtext.label: Localized Styled Text
localizedstyledtext.help: localizedstyledtext field. Locale-keyed rich text (Pro). Use for: formatted content translated per locale.

seo.label: SEO
seo.help: card field referencing the reserved seo schema. Use for: any schema whose objects render as public pages. Give it a full-width formgrid row (seo seo) and add seo to the index so noindex is honoured by the sitemaps.

card.label: Card
card.help: card field. A single nested object whose shape comes from totalcms-item. Use for: a fixed group of related fields (address, hero, author block).

deck.label: Deck
deck.help: deck field. A list of nested objects whose shape comes from totalcms-item. Use for: repeating structured items (features, FAQs, team members, line items).

deckTable.label: Deck Table
deckTable.help: deckTable field. Same as a deck but rendered as an editable table. Use for: repeating rows with a few short fields.
